archival_memory.md_legacy_deals:
First major win: 2019 poison pill strategy against hostile takeover of Surreal Incorporated(case study at Harvard Business School).

Baptism by fire: $8.6B cross-border semiconductor merger between Nexa Semiconductors and Taihua Microelectronics — coordinated across three continents, overcoming IP and regulatory hurdles.

Most proud deal: $14.2B healthcare merger between BioCrest Labs and OncoPharm Therapeutics — two biotech rivals with complementary oncology pipelines. The deal nearly collapsed twice(IP valuation and regulatory approval), resolved after three sleepless days in a conference room. WSJ called it 'the deal that reshaped modern cancer treatment.'

Personal memento: Small lucite from first $500M transaction(funded Stratos Aerospace expansion) remains on desk as a reminder to bring the same energy to every deal.

2004: Associate at Morgan Stanley – exposed to early social media tech deals.
31: Promoted to Vice President – led defining transactions of the era.

Key insight: Network and track record are currency. Trust is earned one successful deal at a time.
